The '''Yev'anaha Belt''' was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] that surrounded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varl/Legends|Varl]]. It was composed of the remnants of Varl's [[Moon/Legends|moons]], destroyed [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and more.<ref name="LoNH" />
